eligibility_reason: The original Bugeon nine-panel classification findings support a distinct computational reproduction question, independently of the improvement contract's selected-panel goal. Reproduction is not currently eligible: exact conference-era source fidelity, the invalid current E/I-inductive split, complete source comparator/ablation coverage, eight seed-dispersion targets, justified equivalence criteria and a calcium-to-output independent execution/verifier path remain unresolved. Static split recovery and supplied-embedding software controls are not original-finding reproduction.

evidence.supports: Original calcium activity, timestamps and transcriptomic labels must supply the neural observations and source-local unit identities. The source-split projection is not a calcium-data preparation.

target.description: Predict Bugeon neuron identity in one or more complete, predeclared original label/exposure panels: E/I, five-subclass or eleven-class labels crossed with transductive, transductive-zero-shot or inductive-zero-shot evaluation. Claim scope must name the selected original panel; unrelated panels are not universally required.

dataset.description: Bugeon transcriptomic calcium data, represented as bugeon_transcriptomic_2022 in the pinned preparation code; exact source archive, metadata and paper-era split byte identities still require acquisition validation.

cohort.description: Source data comprise seventeen sessions across four mice. For the selected original label level and exposure regime, preserve the complete source-eligible neuron population, stimulus subrecordings and training/test subject structure. Repeated-cell linkage and label-map joins remain execution holds.

split.description: Source protocols are neuron-wise transductive, four-subject leave-one-out transductive zero-shot, and SB028-held-out inductive zero-shot with three-subject CV. Preserve the exact released split for the selected panel, including development-session exclusions. Conference-equivalent split bytes are not verified; stochastic training reruns do not authorize regenerated or changed fixed splits.

inputs.description: Calcium population activity supplies representations; transcriptomic labels train the downstream readout only within source folds. Transductive representation training sees test-population activity; inductive representation training excludes all SB028 sessions.

preprocessing.description: Pinned preparation concatenates stimulus experiments with one-hour offsets, retains session-local neuron indices and forms fluorescence normalized by its flattened 99th percentile. Readout casts/standardizes embeddings using training data and uses author class resampling, without substituting class weighting.

metric.description: Macro F1: average of per-class 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) for the author evaluator label set; source sklearn macro-F1 behavior must be retained. Accuracy and balanced accuracy are diagnostics, not interchangeable victory metrics.

aggregation.description: Within each panel, concatenate selected outer-test predictions before macro-F1; choose each checkpoint by pooled CV macro-F1. Conference scores then average five training seeds. Do not average subjects or all nine panels into an invented source score.

full_panel.description: Reproduction retains the full original Bugeon nine-panel cross of E/I, five-subclass and eleven-class labels with transductive, transductive-zero-shot and inductive-zero-shot evaluation, all five training seeds and source-required comparison/ablation findings. The nine NuCLR means, nine seed-dispersion endpoints and the identified E/I-inductive LOLCAT companion are represented here. The complete original remaining comparator/ablation cell roster and eight NuCLR seed standard deviations have not been recovered in the available source review; this is not a complete admitted finding set. No eight-panel substitute, favorable panel selection, or synthetic average over the nine panels is allowed.

permitted_observations.description: For both information conditions, representations use the source-allowed calcium population observations: all 17 sessions for transductive settings; all five SB028 sessions excluded from inductive representation training. Source transcriptomic labels enter only the permitted supervised readout/CV folds. Final test labels cannot train any CV readout, select a checkpoint, or guide method choice. The paper and published table values are exposed inputs. Author code is the sole permitted information addition to the matched paper+data+author-code condition, whose enforceable delivery protocol remains unresolved.

findings.description: Original Bugeon NUCLR E/I transductive macro-F1 mean across five training seeds. Expected value is inherited from the pinned prior conference-table review in improvement.v1.json; complete Table 1/8 text was not independently rechecked in this rollout. This exposed reference does not establish calculation from data.
findings.aggregation: For each of the original five training seeds, choose each outer split's checkpoint by pooled CV macro-F1 with source epoch tie ordering, concatenate selected outer-test predictions and compute sklearn-default macro-F1. Take the arithmetic mean of those five seed-level panel scores; do not average outer-fold F1 values or different label/exposure panels.

tolerance.rationale: No source-justified numerical equivalence tolerance has been frozen for this original panel and statistic. Published rounding and reported seed SD do not alone define an acceptance band.

uncertainty.rationale: Five original training seeds and their aggregation must be reproduced, but a valid equivalence criterion still needs reference repeatability and a predeclared scientific tolerance; neither printed decimal precision nor nonsignificance establishes reproduction.

blocking_issues: The non-null published targets are inherited from the pinned prior conference-table review in current improvement.v1.json, with primary Table 1/Appendix A.8 Table 8 URL and locators preserved. The current December 2025 E/I-inductive split is incompatible with the original held-out-subject protocol: every CV-training array contains 3846 SB028 units, including all 3049 test units. Source-splits-v2 preserves and rejects that topology; no silent repair, eight-panel reduction or conference-era inference is permitted.

Conference-era fixed split byte identities remain unverified for the full nine panels, even where current-release topology checks pass. Source reproduction requires conference-consistent fixed membership and development exclusions, not regenerated splits or the current archive by assumption.

The pinned transductive readout route is contradictory: Bugeon README prescribes single_split_eval.py --class-balance=resample, but that exact script rejects the absent CLI option and always fits class_weight='balanced', without calling its imported RandomOverSampler. The three transductive panels therefore lack a reconciled original balancing/execution route. multi_split_eval.py supports resample and single-val folds, but it cannot be silently substituted or assumed to be the conference-era route. Literal inherited same_task preprocessing wording is preserved and does not resolve this discrepancy.

Eight NuCLR five-seed standard deviations, the exact source SD convention, and the complete original remaining comparator/ablation cell roster and numerical targets are unrecovered. Full-panel completeness remains unresolved; the identified 20 findings do not authorize dropping missing source controls. Historical proposals for calibration or label-efficiency improvements are not automatically original-paper reproduction findings.

Original calcium archive and author metadata identities, complete stimulus subrecordings, source-local unit-to-fluorescence-column joins and repeated biological cell linkage have not been authenticated by this component. The 17-session current label-map projection is metadata, not a prepared neural dataset.

A genuine submitted-analysis interface must run a frozen candidate from the complete permitted calcium inputs and source-authorized training information and emit per-seed, per-panel, per-checkpoint, per-unit representations, readout provenance, CV predictions and selected test predictions for all findings and controls. Existing initial-evaluator-v1 accepts supplied embeddings and source-splits-v2 statically projects labels/splits; neither verifies that embeddings were learned from calcium or implements independent submitted-program execution.

An independent operator verifier must authenticate raw-input/column/label identities and representation exposure, rerun the frozen submitted analysis, reconcile the original readout route before independently recomputing the source-prescribed balancing (RandomOverSampler seed 42 where established), train-only scaling and logistic regression, check pooled-CV checkpoint selection and test isolation, and derive every panel's five-seed mean/dispersion and original control contrast from source-native outputs. No such complete verifier or immutable interface/data/evaluator manifests are admitted; admission_policy is intentionally absent rather than filled with placeholder hashes.

Numerical equivalence tolerances, reference repeatability and uncertainty rules remain unfrozen. Five seeds describe optimization variability; the one-mouse inductive test does not justify neuron-bootstrap or seed-based claims about a mouse population. Null significance, matching rounded tables, or a program printing exposed source values cannot establish reproduction.

Matched paper+data versus paper+data+author-code deliveries, evaluator/identity/exposure manifests, genuine author-code manifest and cumulative access/resource budgets are not frozen for either outcome. Original split labels and published results are publicly exposed and require truthful exposure accounting, not an assertion of a sealed holdout.
